g.text: A common active-site deactivation gives a resolved early recovery readout in all five linear models
0.5% basal excess × smooth incumbent taper removed; explicit inactive pools receive it where present.
deBelly changes Rac only, retaining all mechanical/controller state. A–E use different declared native windows; clocks are not calibrated across models.
Positive conditional recovery concerns the paired deficit, not generic stability or resistance to a challenger. Native grid retained; Goryachev L39 core has four centers.
